title: Front end Developer
description:
​**Key Responsibilities**

* ​**Mobile App Development:** Design, build, and maintain high-performance, reusable, and reliable code using **React Native** for both iOS and Android platforms.
* ​**UI/UX Implementation:** Collaborate with UI/UX designers to convert wireframes, user flows, and designs into pixel-perfect, fluid mobile interfaces.
* ​**API Integration:** Connect mobile applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and backend services (Node.js, Firebase, etc.).
* ​**Performance Optimization:** Diagnose and fix performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and UI rendering lags to ensure smooth 60fps animations and responsiveness.
* ​**State Management:** Implement and manage application state effectively using modern state management libraries (e.g., Redux Toolkit, Context API, Zustand).
* ​**Testing & Quality Assurance:** Write clean, maintainable code, conduct unit/integration testing, and participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
* ​**Deployment Support:** Assist in preparing and publishing application builds to Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console.

​**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* ​**Experience:** 0 to 2 years of hands-on experience building mobile applications with React Native (professional experience, robust internships, or high-quality portfolio/open-source projects will be considered).
* ​**Core Technologies:**
* ​Strong proficiency in **JavaScript (ES6+)** and **TypeScript**.
* ​Solid understanding of **React core concepts** (Hooks, Component Lifecycle, Virtual DOM).
* ​Familiarity with native mobile development concepts (Xcode for iOS, Android Studio for Android) is a strong plus.
* ​**Tools & Ecosystem:** Experience with REST APIs, third-party native modules, Git version control, and package managers (npm/yarn).
* ​**Problem-Solving:** Good debugging skills and a willingness to learn new tools and frameworks quickly.
* ​**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

Pay: Up to ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Junior Frontend Developer – Immediate Hiring
description:
**About the Role**

Advex Media is looking for a creative and detail-oriented **Junior Frontend Developer** to join our web development team.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of frontend development and a passion for building visually appealing, responsive, and user-friendly websites. You will work with our design and development teams to convert website designs into functional web pages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user-friendly website interfaces.
* Convert UI designs and layouts into functional web pages.
* Build and maintain websites using **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Ensure websites work smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Customize website layouts, animations, and interactive elements.
* Work with WordPress and Elementor to implement frontend layouts when required.
* Identify and fix frontend bugs and display issues.
* Optimize web pages for loading speed and performance.
* Collaborate with designers and backend developers to implement project requirements.
* Maintain consistency in layout, typography, spacing, and visual presentation.
* Test websites across different browsers and screen sizes.
* Stay updated with modern frontend development practices and tools.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their **updated CV and portfolio/GitHub profile** through:

**WhatsApp:** +91 86068 60900  
**Email:** hello@advexmedia.com

title: Frontend Developer (React Js + Nextjs)
description:
We (Zapiotech.com)are seeking a talented Frontend Developer with strong expertise in API integration, GSAP animations and pixel-perfect design conversion. You will work closely with our design and backend teams to deliver high-quality, responsive, and visually engaging websites for client projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain front-end interfaces using Next.js and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Convert Figma/Adobe XD designs into responsive, pixel-perfect web pages.
* Integrate with RESTful APIs to deliver dynamic, data-driven experiences.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, and QA teams for smooth project delivery.
* Optimize websites for speed, SEO, and accessibility.

**Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in Next.js and React.js, with practical experience building production-ready applications.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and responsive web design.
* Experience with TypeScript and type-safe React/Next.js development.
* Hands-on experience integrating RESTful APIs using Fetch API, Axios, or similar tools.
* Expertise in converting Figma, Adobe XD, or PSD designs into pixel-perfect, responsive web interfaces.
* Proficiency in Tailwind CSS and modern CSS layouts, including Flexbox, Grid, and responsive breakpoints.
* Understanding of Next.js App Router, layouts, routing, Server Components, and Client Components.
* Knowledge of state management solutions such as React Context, Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with authentication, authorization, cookies, sessions, and secure API request handling.
* Experience with Git/GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and frontend performance optimization skills.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals, semantic HTML, web accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser compatibility.
* Ability to write clean, reusable, scalable, and maintainable code.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* React: 2 years (Required)
